backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend canister with state and logic for user profiles, products, orders, cart, bills, recharge orders, and shop settings, with role-based access control via AccessControl and blob storage via MixinStorage.
backend/migration.mo: Stub migration module that performs a no-op upgrade, returning the old actor state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels, covering admin authentication, login page routing, backend actor availability fixes, and related UI/backend changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short summaries describing each component's or hook's purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with PWA meta tags, manifest link, Inter font import, and a root div for mounting the React application.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store defining app name, icons, theme colors, display mode, and start URL.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers for cache management.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining all application routes, with public routes (home, checkout, login, etc.) and admin routes (/admin, /admin/dashboard, /admin/billing, /admin/settings) wrapped in AdminGuard for authentication.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Provides admin session management (read/clear from localStorage/sessionStorage) and a route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products to the store, handling fields like name, category, price, stock, barcode, unit type, and image (file upload or URL).
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays all products in an admin list with inline stock editing, product removal, and toggling product exclusion, including low-stock alerts.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Camera-based barcode scanner component using Quagga2 loaded from CDN, supporting flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sound, and scan cooldown.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays a searchable, filterable table of past bills with options to view, print, and export bills to CSV.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a formatted bill receipt with store details, itemized order summary, delivery charge logic, UPI QR code, and options to print or share via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with links to Home, Search, Orders, and Wallet, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Renders a fixed floating action button in the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to a hardcoded number when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-in sheet drawer displaying the user's cart items with totals, a clear cart option, and a checkout button that checks shop open/closed status before allowing checkout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable list of category filter buttons that highlights the selected category and calls a callback when a category is chosen.
Displays a static informational alert describing the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays a destructive alert with error details, stack trace, and options to retry or go home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer showing store name, contact info (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright line with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header with store logo, shop open/closed indicator, admin dashboard link, cart icon with item count badge, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing image carousel with three promotional banners, manual prev/next arrow controls, and dot indicators, cycling every 4 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapper that composes Header, Footer, CallUsButton, BottomNavBar, and WhatsAppHelpButton, hiding the bottom nav on admin paths.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A React section component that lets users place mobile recharge orders by selecting an operator, entering a 10-digit number and amount, with form validation and a dialog for submission flow.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment card with a UPI QR code image, the amount to pay, and step-by-step payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a single product card with image, name, category, price, stock badges, and an add-to-cart button that is disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of ProductCard components, showing skeletons while loading and an empty-state image when no products match the selected category.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows a red banner at the top of the page when the shop status is confirmed closed, using the shop status query hook.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: An alert dialog that automatically appears when the shop transitions from open to closed, or when externally triggered, redirecting the user to the home page on dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: An admin toggle switch that opens or closes the shop, requiring Internet Identity authentication, with loading and error states handled via toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: A fixed floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat with the store's phone number when clicked.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, attaching the user's Internet Identity if authenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, cart, orders, bills, recharge orders, UPI ID, shop slogan, and shop status.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds print and animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with hardcoded credentials that stores a session (with optional remember-me) in localStorage or sessionStorage and redirects to the admin panel on success.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for managing orders, products, bill history, and shop status, including order status progression actions.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring UPI ID, shop slogan, and shop status, requiring Internet Identity authentication to persist changes to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that lets staff search/scan products, manage a cart, and generate a printable bill with customer details.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout form page that collects delivery details and payment method, calculates totals with a conditional delivery fee, and places an order via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page composing a hero carousel, shop-closed banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Order history page that fetches all orders and displays them with status badges and timestamps, requiring authentication to view.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Post-checkout confirmation page showing the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or cash-on-delivery instructions based on the selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Product search page with a sticky search input that filters products by name or category and displays results in a two-column grid.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Displays store information for 'Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point' including contact, location, delivery policy, hours, services list, and an embedded Google Maps iframe with call/directions buttons.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Renders a wallet page showing available cashback balance, a how-it-works info card, and a transaction history list (currently empty with a placeholder state).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with oklch-based design tokens, custom fonts, shadows, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for an e-commerce shop app, documenting known admin authentication/lockout issues, existing features, and architectural notes about the admin panel and backend actor availability.
